messages:
talia (product): quick sync from roadmap grooming: model pinning + quota controls are dragging the milestone. two options: keep MVP date but ship with single pinned model + soft quota, or delay to finish multi-model routing + strict quotas. leaning to keep date. need fast call.
dev (eng): multi-model routing depends on policy engine and a short-circuit for fallbacks. building full policy + audit is ~2w. single pinned model cuts a week.
hamid (eng-ml): pinning to one model simplifies KV cache behavior and stabilizes token costs. downside: customers lose ability to pick cheaper variants. Could ship with an opt-in beta flag for dedicated customers.
yana (solutions): pilots care about deterministic cost and predictable latency. Many will accept a pinned model for GA as long as we offer a roadmap to variant routing in v1.
greg (sales): two strategic pilots (Orion & Nova) need per-tenant quota controls. Could we offer manual per-tenant quotas for pilots and automate later? they'd accept a short-term addendum.
talia (product): strawman: MVP = single pinned model per region, soft quota (warnings + manual bump), v1 = multi-model routing, per-tenant strict quotas + auto-throttle. v1 buffer = +13 days. Thoughts?
dev (eng): agree. we'll need gating: if usage spike >150% of forecast on canary we hold pilot. I'll add metrics: `quota_warn_rate` and `fallback_rate`.
hamid (eng-ml): also propose a reduced-batch path for pinned model to keep 99p latency under 250ms. I'll add a perf flag `--pinned-fastpath` in serving.
yana (solutions): I'll tell pilot customers: GA has pinned model guarantee; advanced routing in v1. Offer manual quota updates for Orion/Nova if needed. Greg can coordinate contract addendum.
greg (sales): will draft addendum and get legal to sign off. Need owners for manual bump ops.
talia (product): owners: dev -> gating metrics + runbook for manual quota bumps, hamid -> pinned-fastpath perf flag + validation tests, yana -> customer comms + pilot ops, greg -> contract addendum. CI-bot: canary deploy 20421 started for release/mvp-pin. status: running.
dev (eng): PR for runbook + metric dashboards by EOD. If canary shows `fallback_rate > 0.5%` or `99p latency > 300ms` we abort pilot.
talia (product): decision recorded. action items: update milestone board, create manual-bump playbook, schedule v1 +13 days, notify pilots. :white_check_mark:
